name: localSection_of_primitive
summary: Take the unique representative r_q with y·r_q primitive; the defining sum has only that term.

steps.claim: By property (2) of `exists_common_coset_reps` there is exactly one coset q with y·r_q primitive; take g = r_q. For Ψ vanishing off the primitive matrices, only the term of q in the sum defining localSection(χ, y)(Ψ) can be non-zero, so property (1) with t = {q} gives localSection(χ, y)(Ψ) = χ(det r_q)Ψ(y·r_q).
steps.lean:
exists_common_coset_reps.choose_spec.elim fun _ ⟨S,
  R⟩ ↦ (R y hy).1.imp' _ fun p ↦ .imp_right (by intros; erw [S {p}] <;> aesop)
